title: WHAT IF YOU WERE IMMORTAL? ⏳🌌 (The Trillion Year Curse) #Shorts
description:
What if you could NEVER die? ⏳😱
At age 25, Pip stopped aging. Bullets bounce off his skin. For 300 years he lived like a god—mastering 16 languages, earning $30 billion, and outliving 14 empires!

But by year 3000, every friend, wife, and child died in his arms while Earth turned into an ash wasteland. 5 billion years later, the Sun exploded, and Pip was thrown into deep space, drifting frozen in the dark void for 3 trillion years completely alone!

Until an ancient cosmic artifact offers one final choice...

═══════════════════════════════════════════
💬 WHAT WOULD YOU DO?
👉 Option A: "DRINK THE CURE! (Live 80 normal years & die peacefully with loved ones)"
👉 Option B: "REMAIN IMMORTAL! (Drift in space until the next universe is born)"

Drop your choice in the comments below! 👇
